description: This file contains utility functions related to file and directory handling, such as ensuring directories exist, generating timestamped filenames, finding the latest file matching patterns, and joining path components.

methods.name: str ensure_dir(path: str)
methods.description: Ensures that a directory exists at the specified path, creating it if necessary, and returns the path.

methods.name: str timestamped_filename(prefix: str, ext: str = "csv")
methods.description: Generates a filename with a timestamp suffix based on the current UTC time, ensuring it is safe for file naming.

methods.name: Optional[str] latest_file(directory: str, patterns: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Finds and returns the most recently modified file in the specified directory that matches any provided patterns.

methods.name: str join(*parts: str)
methods.description: Joins multiple path components into a single path using the OS-specific separator.

ctags.name: latest_file
ctags.pattern: /^def latest_file(directory: str, patterns: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> Optional[str]:$/
